text:
max: quick QA — spotted a mismatch in the cost/latency snippet on the Console docs. the PromQL example for 'cost per token' is querying `cpu_seconds_total` but our compute attribution uses `gpu_seconds_total`. could cause big downstream confusion for infra teams.

olivia: ugh, yes that would be wrong. can you paste the snippet here so i can check? :eyes:

max: sure — here's what the doc currently shows:
```promql
rate(cpu_seconds_total{job="inference"}[5m]) / sum(rate(tokens_generated[5m]))
```

olivia: yep that looks like the issue. should be `gpu_seconds_total` for dedicated/dgpu hosts. for hosted maybe we need a conditional note.

docs-bot: PR suggestion: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/ — use the template to submit small fixes.

sam: i can submit a tiny PR to update the query + add a short note about "which metric to use per deployment". also noticed the JS SDK snippet still references `token_count` instead of `tokens`. want me to include that rename?

emily: include it. also add a line that the dashboard's aggregation window assumes 5m and sequence length distribution affects per-token cost numbers — otherwise people will misinterpret p50 vs p95.

kevin: i'll run the dashboard locally to confirm widget behavior. current widget in `dashboards/cost-breakdown.json` uses `median` aggregation, not p95 — agree we should surface that in docs or change widget default.

max: thanks @kevin. can you also add a short migration note under the "breaking changes" section so customers with pinned presets know what to expect?

kevin: yep — adding a small subsection and a sample query for hosted vs dedicated. pinging @maria and docs-reviewers for quick eyes :pray:

sanjay: FYI there's an open issue (#342) about batch_size affecting tail latency; might be good to link it in a "known caveats" bullet so readers know to check batching config when they see latency-cost anomalies.

max: good call, i'll add a one-liner and link to the issue.

deploy-bot: New PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — title: "fix: cost/latency snippet labels + widget tweak"

maria: thanks — i'll review the PR this afternoon and flag if we need a follow-up for release notes. :+1:

max: sweet. plan: sam opens the PR, kevin updates dashboard JSON, i add the migration note and the batch_size caveat, then maria approves and we merge. timeline: today or tomorrow depending on review.

olivia: tiny nit — can we also add a short example of the expected delta between cpu vs gpu-based accounting in the text? a single number example helps non-infra readers.

sam: yep, i'll include a short illustrative table (2-3 rows) in the PR.

maria: thanks team — will prioritize review after lunch.

max: thanks everyone. closing loop here, i'll post the merged PR link once done.
